mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPERATOR_NOTI_SETTING ( USER_SN, RSVT_NOTI_YN, INQR_NOTI_YN, STLM_NOTI_YN, MKTG_NOTI_YN, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT, RGTR_SN, DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{userSn}, #{rsvtNotiYn}, #{inqrNotiYn}, #{stlmNotiYn}, #{mktgNotiYn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{userSn}, 'N' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE RSVT_NOTI_YN = VALUES(RSVT_NOTI_YN), INQR_NOTI_YN = VALUES(INQR_NOTI_YN), STLM_NOTI_YN = VALUES(STLM_NOTI_YN), MKTG_NOTI_YN = VALUES(MKTG_NOTI_YN), MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{userSn}, DEL_YN = 'N'
